quests.title: Akitsu Yuugei

dialogue.t: Akitsu Yuugei... Both Ei and Heizou mentioned that game before. Shall we check it out?
This should be where people play Akitsu Yuugei. This place seems to be opening back up, just like Ei said.
Paimon doesn't really see anyone here though... Heizou said that we can start the game by talking to the Bulletin Board, so Paimon thinks we should try that.
We should still be careful though. Paimon really doesn't want to be trapped here!

quests.description: Both Ei and Heizou mentioned this mysterious game. Go to the beach and check it out.
